description: Manifests + vendored CRD schemas (design commit 2, `feat(k8s)`): add the CNPG Cluster + ScheduledBackup and the Spotahome RedisFailover base manifests, project the CNPG-generated pg-app discrete keys into the app/migration pods, add the Sentinel ConfigMap vars, vendor the four CRD JSON schemas, and extend the k8s-check comment + drop the dead CronJob skip entry. Depends on FEAT-001 (the app now reads PG_* / Sentinel env). NOTE: this FEAT's `uv run poe k8s-check` will still FAIL at the overlay render because dev/prod kustomizations still patch the db-backup CronJob that is deleted in FEAT-003 — that is expected; this FEAT's own gate is the base render + the two JSON-parse/schema checks, and full k8s-check turns green at the end of FEAT-003.
steps: Before wiring secretKeyRef, confirm the CNPG `pg-app` generated key names (username/password/host/port/dbname) against the shipped CNPG 1.24+ line (design flags these as the stable discrete keys).

Create deploy/k8s/base/postgres-cluster.yaml: CNPG `Cluster` (apiVersion postgresql.cnpg.io/v1) metadata.name `pg`, labels app.kubernetes.io/name: k8s-fastapi-starter. spec: `instances: 3`; `postgresql.synchronous: {method: any, number: 1}` with an inline comment 'quorum ANY 1 — tolerates one standby down, never loses an acknowledged commit'; `enableSuperuserAccess: false` (explicit, commented 'set outright, version-independent'); `storage: {size: PLACEHOLDER_DB_STORAGE_SIZE, storageClass: PLACEHOLDER_DB_STORAGE_CLASS}`; `affinity: {enablePodAntiAffinity: true, topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname, podAntiAffinityType: preferred}` (comment: CNPG manages its own PDB; do NOT ship a Postgres PDB); concrete `resources` (requests cpu 250m/memory 256Mi, limits cpu '1'/memory 1Gi); `bootstrap.initdb: {database: app, owner: app}` with `initdb.secret` DELIBERATELY OMITTED (inline comment: omitting it makes CNPG GENERATE the pg-app Secret); `serviceAccountTemplate.metadata.annotations: {eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_ROLE_ARN}`; `backup.barmanObjectStore: {destinationPath: s3://PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_BUCKET/PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_PREFIX, s3Credentials: {inheritFromIAMRole: true}, wal: {compression: gzip}, data: {compression: gzip}}` and `backup.retentionPolicy: "30d"` (comment: bucket default SSE-KMS from bootstrap_backups.py encrypts every object with the CMK).

Create deploy/k8s/base/scheduledbackup.yaml: `ScheduledBackup` (postgresql.cnpg.io/v1), spec.schedule `"0 0 3 * * *"` with an inline comment 'CNPG 6-field (seconds-first) cron = 03:00:00 UTC daily — intentional, NOT 5-field', spec.cluster.name `pg`, spec.backupOwnerReference `self`, labels app.kubernetes.io/name: k8s-fastapi-starter.

Create deploy/k8s/base/redis-failover.yaml: Spotahome `RedisFailover` (apiVersion databases.spotahome.com/v1) metadata.name `redis`, labels app.kubernetes.io/name: k8s-fastapi-starter. spec.sentinel.replicas 3; spec.redis.replicas 3 with resources (and securityContext if kube-linter requires it — verify on the render); spec.auth.secretPath `app-secrets` with an inline comment 'operator reads the `password` key'.

deploy/k8s/base/configmap.yaml: add data keys `REDIS_SENTINEL_HOSTS: "rfs-redis:26379"` and `REDIS_MASTER_NAME: "mymaster"` (non-secret; comment that these put both cluster overlays in Sentinel mode and no REDIS_URL is set in-cluster).

deploy/k8s/base/deployment.yaml: in the api container, add env entries PG_HOST/PG_PORT/PG_USER/PG_PASSWORD/PG_DBNAME each `valueFrom.secretKeyRef: {name: pg-app, key: host|port|username|password|dbname}`. Keep the existing `envFrom` (configMapRef app-config + secretRef app-secrets — now carries REDIS_PASSWORD). Do NOT project the pg-app `uri` key.

deploy/k8s/base/migration-job.yaml: same PG_* secretKeyRef env on the migrate container (alongside the existing DD_TRACE_ENABLED=false env and the app-config/app-secrets envFrom); add a comment that migrations run against the CNPG primary Service `pg-rw`.
deploy/k8s/base/kustomization.yaml: add `postgres-cluster.yaml`, `scheduledbackup.yaml`, `redis-failover.yaml` to resources: (removal of backup-serviceaccount.yaml / backup-cronjob.yaml is FEAT-003).

Vendor the four CRD schemas under deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/ with CANONICAL kind casing (kubeconform 0.8.0 has no toLower; template is {{.ResourceKind}}_{{.ResourceAPIVersion}}.json): Cluster_v1.json, ScheduledBackup_v1.json, Backup_v1.json (CNPG), RedisFailover_v1.json (Spotahome). Primary source = datreeio/CRDs-catalog raw URLs (postgresql.cnpg.io/cluster_v1.json, scheduledbackup_v1.json, backup_v1.json; databases.spotahome.com/redisfailover_v1.json). The Spotahome one is the at-risk entry: fallback is to fetch the operator CRD at a PINNED release ref (CloudNativePG 1.24+ release assets for CNPG; spotahome/redis-operator manifests/databases.spotahome.com_redisfailovers.yaml for Redis) and run openapi2jsonschema on spec.versions[].schema.openAPIV3Schema, then rename to canonical kind casing. Prefer CRD-derived for Cluster and RedisFailover if the catalog schema is looser than the fields this repo sets.

deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/README.md: extend the Files/apiVersions table with the four new kinds and add PER-FILE provenance (catalog raw URL, or operator repo + pinned release tag + CRD filename + openapi2jsonschema command); restate kind-collision safety (Cluster/ScheduledBackup/Backup/RedisFailover do not collide with Application/ExternalSecret/ClusterSecretStore across groups, so kind+version resolution stays unambiguous).

pyproject.toml [tool.poe.tasks.k8s-check]: add a comment that the CNPG + Redis kinds are now among the CRDs pass (b) must resolve, and DROP the now-dead `CronJob` entry from the pass-(b) `-skip` list (no CronJob is rendered after FEAT-003 deletes the backup CronJob).
acceptance_criteria: `kubectl kustomize deploy/k8s/base` renders the Cluster, ScheduledBackup, and RedisFailover CRs with the expected fields and PLACEHOLDER tokens intact.
Each of the four vendored schema files is valid JSON that kubeconform resolves by kind+version (proven green by full k8s-check at the end of FEAT-003).
deployment.yaml and migration-job.yaml project PG_HOST/PG_PORT/PG_USER/PG_PASSWORD/PG_DBNAME from secretKeyRef name pg-app, and keep the app-secrets envFrom.
configmap.yaml carries REDIS_SENTINEL_HOSTS and REDIS_MASTER_NAME; no REDIS_URL is added anywhere in-cluster.
pyproject k8s-check pass-(b) -skip list no longer names CronJob.
verification: kubectl kustomize deploy/k8s/base  (renders the three CRs; PLACEHOLDER tokens present)
python -c "import json,glob; [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/*.json')]"  (all vendored schemas parse)
uv run poe check  (confirm FEAT-001 app code still green)
